summary: Complete testing of legal compliance features for Culture Connect 2026: Cookie banner, static HTML legal pages, legal footer links, and RGPD checkbox. All 10 features tested and verified working.

cookie_banner: Cookie banner appears on first visit (after localStorage cleared)
Accept button stores consent with analytics:true in localStorage
Decline button stores consent with analytics:false in localStorage
static_legal_pages: Politique de Confidentialité page accessible at /legal/politique-confidentialite.html
All legal pages have 'Retour à l'accueil' link that navigates to homepage
legal_footer: Footer visible on homepage with data-testid='footer'
rgpd_checkbox: RGPD checkbox visible on registration Step 3 (Objectifs)
Privacy policy link in consent text
Error message shows when submitting without consent

context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal compliance fully implemented with dual system: 1) React components for SPA routes (/mentions-legales, /confidentialite, /cgu, /cookies) and LegalFooter, CookieBanner, RGPDCheckbox components, 2) Vanilla JS /public/legal/legal-compliance.js for static HTML pages (/legal/*.html). Cookie consent uses localStorage key 'cc_cookie_consent'. RGPD checkbox has data-testid='rgpd-checkbox' on registration form Step 3. All legal pages have proper French content.

cookie_banner.implementation: React CookieBanner component + Vanilla JS fallback
